notes.title: Quatro 1.0 Update!
notes.notes:
Here it is! 1.0. A huge thanks to everyone who played during early access!

Swapping Hands
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037117/b67df30d0d9008afdc51a3e475d45beff99b67e4.gif

Sometimes you just want to give a gift to your friends, Now you can! (Friends not included)

All new animations and effects
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037117/e2e04297a2a9f934f95477f680889eafed9683ed.gif

It almost feels like someone who knows what their doing made this! Almost.

Card Highlights
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037117/eab5e273dbea9125689cb66ad630b6b1b3db5046.png

It helps to see which +4 you can stack.

Overhauled Lua Editor
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037117/3fd78cf2454f250cd8a3f4b6e32f2ddfe747e390.png

So fancy.

And a new, out of this world DLC! "Quatro! - Eclipse DLC"

But that's not all, there was a ton of smaller things. Go check it out!

A Detailed List of Changes

Gameplay

 Updated engine
 Optimized all shaders to improve performance
 Improved card rendering
 Improved player card rendering
 New Animation system
 More sound effects
 Deck/Hand swapping
 Highlight playable cards
 Updated achievement graphics
 Updated login
 Menu transitions
 Updated DLC menu
 Some gameplay timing changes
 Updated Quatro! Advanced deck


Mods

 An updated lua editor window
 Better lua highlighting
 Updated lua backend
 Added player.swapHands and players.current
 Support for multiple askPlayer/Color requests
 Iterating players
 Visual scripting draw to player
 Optional card count indicators on player.draw()

notes.title: The Workshop Update!
notes.notes:
Been a while, but here we are with a new update right in time for summer!

 Workshop Support 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037117/281140c6e0c443819b7931cadcd36d6d84f79c36.png
Tired of the same old decks? Well now you can make, share, and use decks from the workshop!

Controller Support
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037117/3b9970b13eba8fd35d121a1090dbf3256ca60dd6.png
Mouse and keyboard are cool, but sometimes you just want a controller, you know?

Player and Color Selection
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037117/8e1e4d5933ca33074a1ecd223eb0141f7ef26b89.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037117/a0aaaf78710e368b8e66af5f0e9fabf95b3667fd.png
You may have noticed, but there wasn't a way to pick a color before... Until now! Players can now pick either colors or players during matches, this is also accessibile in:

Modding Changes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037117/9d73bbefe6dbcd04cd88e6cb5b2c52342a251999.png
There's now a new player API for those lua modders out there! Which allows you to access the state of each player in game! As well as initial variable values, static variables, and a whole new text editor for custom scripts!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037117/b5212f878cc4d7c29f7a4af1d4eed7b5c121fc8a.png
You can also now use emoji and rich text tags on card titles! check out more in the documentation

New Deck
The boring old mystery deck has been replaced by "Quatro! Advanced" which uses the new modding features.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037117/8f8b2bbcabf47beb04ed5059606994a771f2e9c2.png

And of course, don't forget the new "This is fine DLC", to show all your friends how you feel inside.

A Detailed List of Changes

Mods

 Added static variables
 Added a dedicated editor for lua scripts
 Added full emoji support to text rendering
 Player input support for option selection
 Added workshop support
 Added discarding
 Variable initalizers


Gameplay

 Added a bot fill option to lobbies
 Added controller support with input switching
 Fixed potential save corruption issue
 Gameplay loop tweaks
 Updated unity to 2022.2

notes.title: Optimization Patch 2: Electric Boogaloo
notes.notes:
Quatro! used a lot more GPU than expected, but not anymore!
This patch should finally make the game run much smoother for everybody, and use WAY LESS GPU.

So why did it use so much GPU anyway?
While the game itself runs pretty light the graphics presets were not properly updated to match. The game was trying to run like some kind of unoptimized AAA game.

Through testing I've gone from ~30% GPU usage to <10% though the change should be bigger on some computers.

notes.title: The Modding Update!
notes.notes:
Starting off the new year with a new update! Things are gonna get a lot more crazy...

Lobby Changes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037117/b0858e45ad8106b91abbc39e1ee092063bbd65c2.jpg
You can now play matches with up to 8 players! Invite all your friends (Or bots most likely) and suffer together!

Deck Stacking
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037117/af6edd33e41fc26f1e06e53bd8bfc3abec20c596.png
One deck not enough? Want to mix and match? Well now you can with the new deck multiselect mode!

DLC Selection
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037117/847477c1a558a2e4b839db3fb60dc1055571bfab.jpg
Tired of seeing that WIP DLC button? Well now it works! Along with the new animated KittyWave DLC to show off with!

Modding Changes
Alright and now a big one; The modding system. Mods will now be much more stable and matches should have way less gamebreaking issues.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037117/f86fc4dbfcef891b5becb23985128058bce338ae.png
The whole modding menu has been redesigned and now has its own consistent look. Along with the menu changes you can finally change the amount of a cards in a deck!

Even better for those advanced users, we now have a link to Quatro's documentation in the menu.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037117/7e4b7bc4975446716e81c1efbdf4bed8889bdb24.png

Previously, there have been issues with the mod system not working in specific cases. These issues have been fixed. Make sure to load and edit anything necessary if your mods weren't working before.

A detailed list of changes:

Mods

 Modding variables have been "unbroken"
 Fixed OnTurn scripts not running properly
 Modding menu redesign
 Mods will now log errors to game logs
 Custom code block has syntax checking
 Decks file format has been switched to readable json files
 Card amounts can be set in the editor
 Fixed "no decks" showing after creating deck
 Mod editor now has sounds
 Added documentation button
 Added "flip direction" code block
 Added QOL methods to lua


Gameplay

 Switched to the new Unity Input System and redone menu system for future reasons...
 Increased player max to 8
 DLC can be selected from menus
 Multiple decks can be selected from deck selection.
